title: Delhi Capitals Stun Punjab Kings With Stunning Dharamsala Chase
excerpt: Axar Patel and David Miller's twin fifties power DC to a 3-wicket win, handing PBKS their fourth straight loss in IPL 2026.
body:
Delhi Capitals captain Axar Patel led from the front on Monday, May 11, as DC chased down 211 runs against Punjab Kings at Dharamsala's Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association Stadium with an over to spare — a nervy, exhilarating win that keeps their faint playoff hopes alive in IPL 2026.

**What happened — a chase built on character:**
PBKS posted a competitive 210/8 in 20 overs, with Priyansh Arya blazing 56 off 33 balls and Shreyas Iyer anchoring an unbeaten 59. DC lurched to 38/3 inside five overs, with the match seemingly slipping away. Then Axar Patel and David Miller took centre stage. Axar smashed 56 off 30 balls — his maiden fifty of the season — while Miller delivered a 27-ball 51 before falling to Ben Dwarshuis. Tailenders Madhav Tiwari and Auqib Nabi finished the job with six balls to spare, Nabi sealing the win with a six.

**Why it matters — context and stakes:**
The win lifts DC to seventh in the points table with 10 points from 12 matches. Punjab Kings, once the tournament's pacesetters, have now lost four consecutive games and remain fourth with 13 points from 11 matches. The Dharamsala dew factor played a role, but DC's victory was built on raw nerve — this is a franchise that had earlier conceded the highest-ever successful chase in T20 history (265) to these same Punjab Kings on April 25. Axar, who averaged a meagre 6.3 with the bat in the preceding eight innings, silenced his critics with precision and power when it mattered most.

**What to watch — the road ahead:**
DC face Rajasthan Royals on May 17 in a game that will almost certainly decide whether their playoff dream survives another week.
